events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Tess: Great, thanks! I’m still waiting on the final time, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Faye: Perfect, just send it over when you have it and I’ll work around the school schedule.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — I heard they’re setting things up as planned.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Kira: Okay, good — I just wanted to make sure it hadn’t been called off.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated tools and greet people at the table.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Tess: Yep, that sounds great — I heard they’re setting things up as planned, so we’re still on track.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there and keep it simple. Send me any last-minute details.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Kira: Good, thanks — I just wanted to confirm it’s still happening.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — I heard they’re setting things up as planned.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I just wanted to be sure it hadn’t been called off.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Eli: I’ll send the times as soon as I have them, and I’ll keep the plan simple. Just let me know the address and pickup contact when you’ve got them.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Great, I’ll pass that along and get you the address plus pickup contact as soon as I’ve got them.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Sounds good, Tess. Once you’ve got the address and pickup contact, send them my way and I’ll keep to the plan.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Dane: I’ve got it — I’ll keep track of the drop-off spots and where each repair item goes.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Dane — thanks for keeping everything sorted. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive so folks know where to drop things off.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Dane: Great, thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an eye on the drop-off spots and the item list.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Bo: What’s the main thing you need for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Tess: Mostly spread the word and keep folks pointed to the drop-off spots. Dane’s tracking where everything goes, so I’m just making sure neighbors know the repair drive is still on.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Bo: Got it — I can help spread the word and point folks to the drop-off spots.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. If you can help spread the word and bring any broken items that need fixing, that’d be a big help.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and I’ll bring along anything broken that needs fixing.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate it. I’m still a bit fuzzy, so if there’s anything specific you want me to do, just remind me.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring by anything broken that needs fixing.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. I’ll send the repair drive details later and keep it low-key.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I could use quiet help with setup and check-in on Sunday at the community center. Send me the timing details when you can.
events.speaker: Uli

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring a couple broken things that need fixing. I’ll check the timing and send it over as soon as I have it.
